messages.text: Chambers and Sons [SYNTH] says lead times on Charging cable type 10 move from 23 to 32 days.

messages.text: That eats our buffer for Charging cable type 10. Can we pull forward the next order?

title: Lead time slip from Chambers and Sons [SYNTH]
